trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to grind for it. Work the roadmap in order — story chapters first, side strands before the finale, then activities and collectibles cleanup — and keep an eye on the missable flags so a closed window never forces a second playthrough. GTA VI is pre-release; this ordering is derived from the official descriptions listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
steps: Earn the 4 chapter trophies and the final-mission trophy
Finish every side strand before the finale
Clear activities, collectibles and crime trophies
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road
The platinum pops with the last remaining trophy

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing reads as an early story mission — the name pairs with the fishing activity introduced around the same stretch of the game. Play the main story and finish the mission; story missions cannot be skipped, so this unlocks on the critical path. The exact chapter placement is inferred from the official description, since GTA VI is pre-release.
steps: Play the main story until Gone Fishing starts
The trophy unlocks at mission end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing every mission in Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies are unmissable on a normal playthrough — keep following the main missions and it unlocks when the chapter closes. Use Chapter 1 to learn Leonida's systems, since later collectibles and activities build on them.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable if you keep playing the story; the name is reproduced exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Before pushing deep into Chapter 2, it is worth starting side strands early so their finales are not left hanging near the end.
steps: Start side strands as they appear

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3, which by its name brings the story to Vice City in force. Unmissable on the story path. By this point most of Leonida should be open, so it is a good moment to start the map-wide cleanup trophies (exploration, vehicles, collectibles) alongside the story.
steps: Use the open map to start cleanup trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter before the finale. Unmissable on the story path, but treat the end of Chapter 4 as the point of no return for planning: finish side strands and any one-time moments before starting the final mission. That sequencing advice is inferred from the description order, as GTA VI is pre-release.
steps: Finish open side strands before the finale

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The story's closing trophy: complete the final mission. It is unmissable if you finish the game, but starting the finale is the natural point where unfinished side content may lock out, so clear side strands and missable-flagged trophies first. That caution is inferred from the trophy structure rather than confirmed, since the game is pre-release.
steps: Finish side strands and missables first
Complete it to roll the credits

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies unlock simply by finishing the mission, and story missions cannot be skipped, so this is unmissable. If the mission offers optional objectives, they are not required by the description — only completion is tracked.
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a named heist mission. Finish the heist to unlock it; as a story mission it is unmissable. Heists usually gate progress, so expect this to sit on the critical path rather than in optional content — that placement is inferred from the description.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Child's Play. Story missions are mandatory, so the trophy is unmissable — play until the mission appears and finish it. The apostrophe in the mission name is part of the official description as PlayStation publishes it.
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Headliners. Unmissable on the story path: reach the mission and finish it. The trophy name is stylised in capitals exactly as PlayStation lists it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a named mission at the VCIA airport location (the same VCIA named in Catch Me If You Can). Unmissable as a story mission. While you are at VCIA for this mission, remember the airport also hosts the unscheduled-departure trophy — that pairing is inferred from the two descriptions.
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story
Note VCIA for Catch Me If You Can

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable on the story path — play to the mission and finish it. The wintry name is the trophy's own; nothing in the description suggests a weather condition to arrange.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own completion tracker. This is the long cleanup trophy: it typically folds in story, side strands, activities, collectibles and exploration, so it lands near the end of the roadmap. The exact checklist is whatever the in-game stats screen counts — check it regularly; that advice is derived from the description, as the game is pre-release.
steps: Finish the story and all side strands

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total. Stunts are the game's stunt events — jumps and stunt challenges scattered across Leonida — and the counter is cumulative, so chip away at it whenever you pass one rather than saving all 250 for the end. The count of 250 is the tracked number in the official description.
steps: Complete stunts as you pass them

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once — fishing, races, shooting range, bowling, meditation and the rest of the activity roster. You only need to attempt each type, not master it, which makes this a good early trophy: sample everything as it unlocks. The activity list itself is inferred from the other activity trophies' descriptions.
steps: Unlock activities as the story opens them
Check the activity list for any missed type

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. This is a skill trophy: work through the range's challenge list and replay any challenge that ends below gold until the whole set is gold. Practising after story missions that hand you better weapons may help — that tip is inferred, as the game is pre-release.
steps: Play every challenge on its list
Replay sub-gold challenges until all are gold

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each location that hosts one. Visit every drone-race spot on the map and take first place at each; a win at one location does not cover another. Locations are found through the activity markers — that detail is inferred from the description's 'every location' wording.
steps: Find each Top Fun Drone Race location
Win the race at each one
Revisit any location not yet won

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 'different' is the key word, so repeating one easy race 20 times does not count. Spread your wins across 20 distinct race events around Leonida. The tracked count is 20, from the official description.
steps: Do not repeat the same race for credit

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal — a named character — in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities (it also opens the story with Gone Fishing), so find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Whether Cal is met through a side strand is inferred from the description naming him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, play its game through to completion, and the trophy unlocks. Only one game is needed, so pick whichever cabinet you meet first.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's mission strand. Andy is one of the named side characters whose strand has its own finale, so play his missions in order until the last one. Side strands are optional content, which is why this is flagged missable: finish Andy's strand before the story finale in case side content locks out — that lockout risk is inferred, as GTA VI is pre-release.
steps: Meet Andy and start his strand
Finish his final mission before the story finale
trophies.misswindow: Andy is optional side content: if his strand is left unfinished when the story ends, his final mission may no longer be reachable in that playthrough. Finish the strand before the final mission. (Inferred from the description; GTA VI is pre-release.)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Play Kenton's missions through to their finale. As optional side content it is flagged missable: clear the strand before the story's final mission so a possible lockout cannot strand it — the lockout risk is inferred from the trophy structure.
steps: Meet Kenton and start his strand
Finish his final mission before the story finale
trophies.misswindow: Kenton's strand is optional: left unfinished at the story's end, its final mission may be unreachable in that playthrough. Finish it before the final mission. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Work through Billy's missions in order to reach his finale. Optional side content, so it is flagged missable — finish before the story finale in case side strands lock out afterwards (inferred; the game is pre-release).
steps: Meet Billy and start his strand
Finish his final mission before the story finale
trophies.misswindow: Billy's strand is optional side content; if the story ends first, his final mission may lock out for that playthrough. Finish it before the final mission. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The named finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of the strands the list names, so there are at least three more strangers to find. Because strands are optional, this is flagged missable: finish 8 strands before the story finale. The count of 8 is the tracked number in the description.
steps: Complete each strand to its final mission
Finish 8 strands before the story finale
trophies.misswindow: Stranger strands are optional and may lock out after the story finale; complete 8 full strands before starting the final mission. (Lockout inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Play Randy's missions in order through to the finale. Optional side content, flagged missable: finish before the story's final mission in case strands lock out (inferred; pre-release).
steps: Meet Randy and start his strand
Finish his final mission before the story finale
trophies.misswindow: Randy's strand is optional; unfinished at the story's end, its final mission may be unreachable in that playthrough. Finish it before the final mission. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Work through Tyrone's missions to his finale. Optional side content, flagged missable: clear it before the story finale in case side strands lock out afterwards (inferred; the game is pre-release).
steps: Meet Tyrone and start his strand
Finish his final mission before the story finale
trophies.misswindow: Tyrone's strand is optional side content; if the story ends first, his final mission may lock out. Finish it before the final mission. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. Treat the spots like a collectible set: visit each marked spot and meditate once. Spots are spread across the whole state, so pair this with The Goodtime State exploration run to avoid backtracking — that pairing is a route tip derived from both descriptions.
steps: Pair with the full-map exploration run

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, a named character — so this is a task handed out by Bret rather than free-roam hunting. Take his request, track the named animal and complete the hunt. It is flagged missable because a character-given task can be lost if the character's strand is skipped or left until after the finale (inferred; pre-release).
steps: Meet Bret and take his hunting request
Track the unique animal he names
trophies.misswindow: Bret's request is character-given side content; skip Bret or leave him until after the finale and the hunt may be unreachable in that playthrough. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are collectibles scattered across Leonida; gather every card in a set to complete it, and do that for three sets. The tracked count is 3 sets. Because sets span the map, collect cards during exploration rather than in one late sweep.
steps: Complete every card in a set

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK action at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the game's phone-app-style interaction (the capitalisation is PlayStation's own), and the counter tracks distinct locations, so keep using it in new places as you travel. The tracked count is 100. Pair it with exploration to avoid a dedicated grind at the end.
steps: Use it in new locations as you travel

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges are the tracked in-game tasks (the same system that counts toward completion), so work the list steadily instead of leaving 50 for the end. The tracked count is 50, from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner with you, raise a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely — escape the heat until the stars clear. The partner requirement is the twist: do it during free-roam with your partner present, not solo. The tracked number is the 4-star level in the description.
steps: Bring your partner along in free-roam
Break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your Wanted Level alive the whole time — if the stars clear between shops, the chain breaks. Pick three shops close together so the run between them is short. The tracked count is 3 shops; the close-together routing is a tip derived from the 'back-to-back' wording.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 nearby shops
Rob shop one and keep the Wanted Level
Rob shops two and three without the stars clearing

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery is cumulative — every new vehicle type you encounter or drive counts — so vary what you drive instead of sticking to one car. The tracked count is 100. Vehicles you register for On the Spot can double-count toward discovery, a pairing derived from both descriptions.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus, the game's combat ability. Set it up where enemies are grouped — a gang operation or a crowded mission fight — then trigger Combat Focus and clear five before it ends. The tracked count is 5 takedowns in one use.
steps: Find a grouped set of enemies
Take down 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an 'unscheduled departure' at VCIA — the airport also named in the VCIA Takedown mission. The wording suggests stealing or forcing your way onto a departure rather than buying a ticket, so head to VCIA in free-roam and trigger the departure moment. Flagged missable because one-off free-roam moments like this can be tied to a story window (inferred; pre-release) — try it early and keep a save before attempting it.
steps: Keep a save before the attempt
trophies.misswindow: A one-off VCIA moment may only be available during a story window; attempt it early and keep a manual save beforehand. (Inferred from the description; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke line about Rhinos — GTA's tank — so this trophy is about getting into or using a Rhino tank. Tanks are rare, military-grade vehicles, so expect this to hinge on a specific opportunity rather than everyday free-roam. Flagged missable: if a Rhino appears during a mission or event, take the chance then and keep a save before it (inferred; pre-release).
steps: Watch for a Rhino tank opportunity
Keep a save before the moment
Get in and use the Rhino
trophies.misswindow: A Rhino is a rare vehicle; if its appearance is tied to a mission or event, missing that moment can lock the trophy for the playthrough. Keep a save before such moments. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected — a stealth robbery, the opposite of the loud shop robberies in Retail Therapy. Approach unseen, take the loot and leave before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, the attempt fails and can be retried. The retry advice follows from the description's 'without being detected' condition.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — the escape is part of the requirement, so getting caught after cracking a vault does not count. Work through five separate bank vault robberies in free-roam. The tracked count is 5, from the official description.
steps: Find a bank with a vault
Rob the vault and escape clean

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks are moving targets in free-roam: intercept one, take its cash and lose any heat. Only one successful robbery plus escape is needed.
steps: Spot an armored truck in free-roam

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — uncover the whole state map. Drive, fly or boat through every region until no fogged area remains; the in-game map shows what is left. This pairs naturally with meditation spots, WAiNK locations and vehicle discovery, so run them together.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida
Clear the fogged areas on the map
Pair with spots, WAiNK and vehicles

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang, so you need the full set of gangs, not five hits on the same crew. Find each gang's illegal operation, rob it, and move to the next gang. The 'each gang' scope comes straight from the description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. This reads as a small free-roam interaction — find the Ocean Beach bar or viewpoint that serves cocktails and use it. Flagged missable because named one-off interactions can be tied to an early-game window (the trophy's own name hints at the beginning); try it as soon as Ocean Beach is reachable (inferred; pre-release).
steps: Find the cocktail spot with a view
trophies.misswindow: The name suggests an early-game moment; if the interaction is only offered near the start, missing it locks the trophy for the playthrough. Try it as soon as Ocean Beach opens. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom — drive a showroom car out through the glass, 'in classic style'. Find a vehicle showroom, get into a display car and exit by smashing through rather than using the door. Flagged missable because a set-piece like this may be a one-time scripted moment (inferred; pre-release); keep a save before attempting it.
steps: Keep a save before the attempt
Drive a display car out through the glass
trophies.misswindow: A scripted showroom moment may only occur once; keep a manual save before entering a showroom set-piece. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Do the 'follow-through' at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — a named location, so this is a specific bowling-alley moment rather than generic bowling. Visit that alley and complete whatever interaction it offers. Flagged missable because a named-location moment can be tied to a character or story window (inferred; pre-release); go when the alley first becomes available.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Visit when it first opens up
trophies.misswindow: A named-location interaction may be tied to a story or character window; visit the alley as soon as it is available. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: 'A partnership with mass appeal' — the description is deliberately vague, pointing at a story beat about the central partnership rather than a countable task. Trophies worded this way usually unlock at a specific story moment, so it is flagged missable in case that moment depends on a choice (inferred; pre-release). Play the story and keep saves before major partnership decisions.
steps: The trophy should unlock at its story moment
trophies.misswindow: If this story beat depends on a choice, the wrong choice can lock it for the playthrough; keep saves before major partnership decisions. (Inferred from the vague description; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — a choice-driven story trophy. It unlocks when a particular decision is made in the story, and the wording implies the choice itself is what counts. Flagged missable: if only one branch of a choice awards it, picking the other branch locks it for that playthrough (inferred; pre-release), so keep saves before big story choices.
steps: Play the story to its choice points
Keep a save before each major choice
Make the choice to unlock it
trophies.misswindow: Choice trophies can lock on the wrong branch; keep a manual save before every major story choice. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — a story beat built around a retry. Trophies phrased like this are usually tied to one scripted moment, so it is flagged missable in case the moment only happens once (inferred; pre-release). Play the story and keep saves around major set-pieces.
trophies.misswindow: A one-time scripted 'second attempt' moment cannot be replayed in the same playthrough if missed; keep saves around major set-pieces. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — a mystery-flavoured trophy, likely tied to encountering something strange in Leonida (the name nods at UFO-style secrets). Expect a specific discoverable event rather than a counter. Flagged missable because one-off encounters can be time- or place-specific (inferred; pre-release); explore widely and investigate anything odd.
trophies.misswindow: A one-off mystery encounter may be tied to a place or time window; explore thoroughly before the finale. (Inferred; pre-release.)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — hit targets with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-style. The name suggests lining up a group so one pass knocks several down. Only the drive-by melee itself is required by the description; the group setup is a tip derived from the 'Ten Pin' name.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Line up a group of targets
Strike them in a melee drive-by pass

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from crime income (robberies and operations elsewhere in this list), and contacts convert them to clean money — keep laundering until the cumulative total reaches $250,000. The tracked count is the $250,000 figure in the description.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and operations

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The counter is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending on clothes, weapons and gear adds up; top it off late-game when money is plentiful. The tracked count is $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are buyable properties, so this is a money-and-map trophy: find each garage for sale and buy it. Do it after the big earners (heists, laundering) so cash is not a blocker — that ordering tip is derived from the money trophies around it.
steps: Find every garage property for sale
Earn enough cash from heists and crime

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, the in-game vehicle app. Each registered vehicle counts once, so register ten different vehicles as you acquire them; they can overlap with the 100 discovered vehicles for Whip It Good. The tracked count is 10.
steps: Register vehicles as you acquire them
